check_description: AC must not reference UI elements, API endpoints, or DB tables
example_violation: Given the user clicks the blue button

check_description: Then clause must have observable/measurable outcome
Each scenario should have exactly one When clause
example_violation: When user logs in and submits form and pays

check_description: Then should not combine multiple assertions with AND
example_violation: Then user sees message and email is sent and DB updated

check_description: Use business domain language not technical jargon
Each scenario must be independently executable
Every artifact must have at least 2 Gherkin scenarios
